erfenis.koppeling.brief.gekocht: Sold! Guhrrit happily tucks the cheese nibble into his inside pocket. You get the Inheritance Gate and a Delivery Chest. Put the gate in your base and step through to your inheritance. Wahoog!
erfenis.koppeling.brief.kwijt: You don't have Guhrrit's letter on you anymore. Where did that thing go now?
erfenis.koppeling.brief.tekst:
Congratulations, nyeg! You have been chosen (by me, with a die) to take over a lovely piece of land: an old farm on the edge of the Guhmension. Roomy lot, lots of green (SO much green), a charming little shed. Folks call this sort of thing a fixer-upper. The structural report is short but honest: chonky.

Asking price: one (1) cheese nibble. No, that's not a typo. Pay the nibble and you get the Inheritance Gate: put it in your own base and step right onto your little estate. Wahoog!

erfenis.tut.1: First, let's make some room. Open the Top View and click an overgrown clump next to the open middle: Clear! Who knows what you'll find...
erfenis.tut.2: Look at that, open ground! Now build a Chicken Coop (Animals tab). The first one is free, from Grandpa's attic. Wahoog!
erfenis.tut.3: What a lovely coop. Now we just need someone to gather the eggs: residents move in on their own when there's room. A Guh Hut gives more room.
erfenis.tut.4: Your first resident! The neighboring villages have already sent carts. Open the World Map (or later the Market Square) and deliver an order.
erfenis.tut.5: Delivered and paid, now that's being neighbors. Now get the Homestead to level 2: check the Homestead panel to see what's still needed.
erfenis.tut.6: Homestead level 2! My work here is done: I'm going on vacation, nyeg. My bust and a mailbox are in your deco shed. I'll send you postcards!
erfenis.tut.welkom: There you are! Realtor Guhrrit, pleased to meet you. Structural report: chonky. Emotional report: very chonky. But with you here it'll all work out, nyeg!
